changelog:
Initial public release of work-productivity-skillscan-security-workflow-helper.

- Provides practical workflow and checklist support for SkillScan-style security and productivity tasks on Clawhub.
- Tailors outputs to users’ immediate needs, focusing on bug fixes, hardening, reliability, and creating adjacent skills.
- Includes clear validation and output criteria to ensure actionable and reusable results.
- Prefers local-hardware-friendly solutions and minimal cloud reliance in workflow artifacts.
